rights: METHOD AND COUNTS ONLY. The corpus is derivative-cleared-pending and password-gated; it lives on mini and no corpus text, excerpt, transcript, rationale or clip address appears in this repository (ADR-0039 — nwp/nwp is publicly mirrored).
problem: 31.9% of shortlist rows sat past moment_rank 16. Of 1254 such deep rows, 605 were UNFORCED (displaced nothing corroborated) and 649 were CONTESTED (a corroborated in-window moment was passed over). Only 40 contested rows had ever been judged, sampled at 47.5% strict survival, 95% CI [32.9%, 62.5%]. 609 were unjudged.

method.population: d4sample.py's population recomputed from scratch against the shipped artefact before anything was trusted; matched the declared 1254 deep / 649 contested / 605 unforced / 251 LPs exactly
method.partition: 649 contested rows split 16 ways by index mod 16 over (lp_id, deep_moment_id); one claude-opus-5 judging instance per partition
method.judgement: each contested deep row compared against the specific corroborated in-window moment it displaced; KEEP_DEEP or SWAP_TO_INWINDOW with a written reason citing what is in each passage; ABSTAIN where the call turns on doctrine or pedagogy rather than which passage teaches the point
method.sd_cap: agreement always read against max_sources_possible (3 DIR, 2 SD/retreat); no reason reads 3 > 2 across corpora
method.coverage_verified: every partition diffed row-by-row against the independently regenerated population
method.emitted_view: each applied swap emits the exact view the judge assessed; all 361 applicable claimed durations resolved to a real view of the displaced moment

strict_survival.note: SURVIVES only, abstentions excluded from the denominator

was_the_sample_representative.sample_vs_census_agreement: 40/40 survive-vs-swap, but 34 of the 40 carry an explicit reused_from_sample flag — the census carried those verdicts over rather than re-judging them, so this is largely a copy check and is NOT independent corroboration
was_the_sample_representative.extrapolation_was_too_kind: the sample projected ~292 of 649 better replaced (CI 243-435); the census found 362

applied.shape: one-for-one, in place; nothing padded, nothing dropped
applied.provenance: every applied row carries a census_swap block naming the row it replaced, that row's moment_rank, duration and agreement, and the partition that judged it

EXCLUDED_SLICE.why: partition d4-01 was REJECTED by its adversarial verifier (incumbent bias; four counter-evidenced KEEP_DEEP reasons measured against the pool). Rejected judgements are not applied, in either direction.

ASR_CORRUPT.why: the replacement's emitted view is ASR-triplicated (distinct-5gram < 0.75), which the declared recipe treats as disqualifying

UNADDRESSABLE.why: the replacement has no known media URL while the deep row it would replace is openable; a swap may not make a clip less openable

CEILING_UNWINNABLE.why: the displaced moment has no view under the operator's 420 s ceiling, so the slot was never winnable

gate.rule: prove it can REFUSE before trusting it to pass
cases: duplicate moment_id within a learning point
passage attributed to the wrong moment
a swap that makes an openable clip unopenable
a swap naming a row absent from the base
gate.bug_found_by_the_red_proof: the gate's own start/end comparison used (value or -1), so a legitimate start of 0.0 read as missing and produced 26 false findings; fixed before the write
invariants: 251 learning points, no gaps or duplicates
every row resolves in the pool by moment_id + passage_id
no duplicate moment_id within a learning point
row count per learning point invariant (never pad, never drop)
every quoted fragment verbatim in its own emitted clip

measured_cost.note: the swap is not free; buying agreement spends duration

quote_invariant.note: all 649 reasons were written in reported speech, so the hardened detector had nothing to check on the new rows. The Defect 1 invariant holds over them VACUOUSLY, not by measurement, and is recorded that way.

still_owed.detail: judged, but their judgements were rejected by an adversarial verifier that measured four KEEP_DEEP reasons against the pool and found them counter-evidenced. Their 27 swaps were not applied. The verifier's finding runs toward MORE swapping, so these rows are if anything still too deep.

still_owed.item: 322 contested deep rows remain in the artefact
still_owed.detail: all judged — 200 SURVIVES + 83 SURVIVES_CEILING + 4 ABSTAIN + 35 gate-refused. None is unjudged.

still_owed.item: only 1 of 16 adversarial verifier verdicts reached the applying session, and it was a FAIL
still_owed.detail: the other fifteen were reported as passing but their text did not arrive. Fifteen partitions were applied on an assertion of verification plus this session's own independent checks: partition integrity against a from-scratch population, SD-cap conformance, quote fabrication, ceiling, ASR corruption, addressability, and a read-based spot check of 20 swaps drawn by a pre-stated hash rule. That is weaker than sixteen adversarial reads.

still_owed.item: pl clips finish hardcodes census_refused: true
still_owed.detail: scripts/lib/clip-finish-shortlist.py on the unmerged branch clips-finish-ops348 asserts the census was refused. It now reads judged 649 / contested 649 / contested_unjudged 0 / sha_match true / cannot_verify [] from live artefacts, but that one constant is stale and should be measured rather than asserted.

still_owed.item: every verdict is claude-opus-5 judging claude-opus-5's output
still_owed.detail: a bias shared by judge and verifier is invisible here by construction. No number in this report speaks to validity; only the operator's calibration set can.

provenance: MACHINE-RANKED. The shortlist is a shortlist for a human author, not a pick and not gold. No human has reviewed a single one of the 3950 rows.
